   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 18 июн. 2026 г. - 29 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _beescobee_, 29 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Unfortunately this app has been unusable for me. The AI ads (ads for games that use AI art and AI-generated people playing them) don’t go away and the fact that so much of this app consists of AI (the music, the art) is really annoying and disappointing. Also, I have a feeling Nintendo will sue them for using songs from their games… I highly doubt they had those approved. The only feature I enjoyed was the fact that people are utilizing this to get things done but honestly, you don’t need the app to do this."
            2. _handysuchtiii_, 18 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app crashes a few seconds after I open it."
            3. _katsilt_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 2/5: "the app kept crashing no matter what i did"
